title: Factorized Scheduling Principle: Learning Interpretable and Transferable Policies via Structured Additive Functions
abstract: arXiv:2609.36578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scheduling problems arise from repeatedly selecting one item from a set of candidates based on their states. These problems often reduce to assigning priority scores and choosing the highest-ranked item. In this work, we propose a factorized scheduling principle (FSP) framework to learn interpretable and transferable scheduling rules. The FSP framework represents system states as condition distributions and decomposes a global scheduling principle into additive univariate and pairwise components with identifiability constraints. The scheduling principle enables the framework to maintain a simple priority-based structure during deployment. This principle is learned by using a policy-based objective combined with a temporal-difference signal defined on the condition distribution. Experiments on synthetic and realistic scheduling tasks demonstrate the FSP framework's strong performance, interpretability, and zero-shot generalization acros

translated_title: 因子化调度原理：通过结构化加性函数学习可解释且可迁移的策略
translated_abstract: 调度问题源于根据候选集的状态反复从中选择一个项目。这些问题通常可以归结为分配优先级分数并选择排名最高的项目。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个因子化调度原理（FSP）框架，用于学习可解释且可迁移的调度规则。FSP框架将系统状态表示为条件分布，并在可识别性约束下将全局调度原理分解为加性的单变量和成对组件。该调度原理使框架在部署时能够保持简单的基于优先级的结构。这一原理通过使用基于策略的目标函数结合定义在条件分布上的时序差分信号来学习。在合成和实际调度任务上的实验表明，FSP框架具有强大的性能、可解释性和零样本泛化能力。
tldr: 该论文提出因子化调度原理（FSP）框架，通过将全局调度规则分解为带可识别性约束的加性单变量和成对组件，学习可解释、可迁移且具备零样本泛化能力的基于优先级的调度策略。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Factorized Scheduling Principle (FSP) framework that decomposes a global scheduling rule into additive univariate and pairwise components with identifiability constraints, learning interpretable, transferable, and zero-shot generalizable priority-based scheduling policies.
